picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's Claude reportedly produced a verified proof of the Riemann Hypothesis working with a Tel Aviv University mathematician — one of math's deepest open problems — marking a landmark moment for AI-assisted mathematical discovery.
picks.title: AI Takes on the Riemann Hypothesis: What Does It Mean for the Future of Mathematics?

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, convening Fermilab leadership and a DOE Under Secretary to fuse AI/superintelligence with high-performance computing, signals a national-level government strategy to accelerate American science via AI.
picks.title: Genesis Mission assembles Avengers to accelerate American science

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's £10M, NIHR-funded EDITH trial is the world's largest test of AI-assisted mammography, enrolling nearly 700,000 women — a scale that could reshape national breast cancer screening if successful.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.editorial_note: A $22.95 million NSF grant is standing up Kitsune, a new shared supercomputer between Stony Brook and Buffalo that will expand AI and research-computing access across the region.
picks.title: Stony Brook University Receives Hardware for NSF-Funded Supercomputer, Kitsune - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: A $25 million Lilly Endowment gift to Indiana University's Human + AI Learning Ecosystem is a major philanthropic bet on reshaping AI integration across higher education.
picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: Aalto University's coordination of Finland's new FCAI-X national AI flagship — one of six selected centers — reflects significant government-backed strategic investment in AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A three-way collaboration between Vanderbilt, Nashville's transportation department, and Oak Ridge National Lab is field-testing AI traffic control — a concrete academia-government partnership with direct public benefit.
picks.title: Vanderbilt, NDOT, Oak Ridge National Laboratory team up to ease traffic with AI

picks.editorial_note: A UCLA-co-authored Nature Sustainability study quantifying AI data centers' outsized power consumption supplies hard evidence likely to shape energy policy debates around AI's infrastructure footprint.
picks.title: These U.S. data centers use four times the power used in LA

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's CLARKE disaster-response AI earned national recognition and is now expanding across real emergency-responder agencies, demonstrating rare AI research that has moved into operational, life-saving use.
picks.title: Texas A&M disaster-response AI gains national recognition, expanded use among emergency responders – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Stony Brook's AI Innovation Institute teaming directly with OpenAI — which is contributing study design, compute credits, and resources — is a notable industry-academia alliance probing how AI reshapes human creativity.
picks.title: AI Innovation Institute, OpenAI Delve into Human-AI Creativity
